headline: PhysRSI-eval reports five-axis measurements of iterative robot-manipulation improvement
summary: Galbot researchers introduce PhysRSI-eval, a five-axis profile separating first-attempt performance, timing of gains, attained scores, physical interaction budget and recovery from early failure. In the main simulation evaluation, the paper reports six model-plus-runtime systems on 18 manipulation tasks: GPT-6 Astra solved 15, GPT-6.1 Sol 12, GPT-6 Sol 7, GPT-5.6 Sol 1, Claude Opus 5.5 13, and Claude Sonnet 5.5 11. The paper reports that final score, early improvement and budget efficiency can diverge, and exploratory associations between public capability scores and the five outcome axes. It also reports Astra workspace interventions and held-out layout tests. All results remain author-reported. The main comparison has one improvement chain per task; the capability analysis covers six systems without independent validation; Astra's ablation/frozen tests cover six tasks, and transfer evidence comprises three cases.
